author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into Shika-Q in this trailer for the ultra-fast competitive puzzle game played on a 10 × 10 grid, where players connect “Links” to outmaneuver opponents in real time. Shika-Q is available now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 (PS4), and PlayStation 5 (PS5). It is also coming to PC via Steam at a later date.

Combat elements such as attacks, interference, recovery, and special abilities occur simultaneously, creating a strategic experience comparable to fighting games. Its real-time board transformation system demands both rapid decision-making and sharp reflexes. The game features a Single-Player challenge mode, competitive multiplayer, online rankings, and a battle pass system, with ongoing plans for esports expansion.
title: Shika-Q - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Sol Cesto version 1.0 is available now on Steam. Watch the Sol Cesto version 1.0 launch trailer for this tactical roguelite where every decision is a gamble. Version 1.0 brings a brand-new final boss, an additional hidden area, a unique ending for each of the seven playable characters, and progression has been reworked and expanded, which introduces new challenges that unlock characters and items, alongside a dedicated upgrade path for the Peasant.

Blending strategy, risk, and pure chaos, Sol Cesto challenges players to descend into a constantly shifting underground world in search of a long-lost sun. Each move is a calculated risk: choose your path across a combat grid, then face the unknown, monsters, treasure, traps, or something far worse. In this dark and unpredictable world, luck isn’t just a factor… It’s a system to be mastered.
title: Sol Cesto - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the voice cast of Mouse: P.I. for Hire in this latest trailer for the upcoming black and white first-person shooter game inspired by classic 1930s cartoons. Hear from the cast of Mouse: P.I. for Hire as they introduce you to their characters, provide insight into them and what inspired them, and give you a peek behind the scenes. The cast includes Troy Baker (voice of protagonist Jack Pepper), Camryn Grime (voice of Tammy Tumbler), Fred Tatasciore (voice of John Brown), Frank Todaro (voice of Cornelius Stilton), and Florian Clare (voice of Wanda Fuller). 

In Mouse: P.I. For Hire, join Private Investigator Jack Pepper as you clear the streets of Mouseburg from crooked cops and heavily armed gangs in order to get to the bottom of the corruption, kidnapping and murder plaguing the city.

Mouse: P.I. for Hire will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2 on April 16, 2026.

author: GameTrailers
description:
NBA Bounce - GOAT: The Movie: Deluxe Edition is available now on Xbox, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Nintendo Switch, and Steam. Watch the NBA Bounce - GOAT: The Movie: Deluxe Edition launch trailer for this all-in-one bundle, which combines the NBA Bounce base game with both the Retro Party Pack and GOAT: The Movie DLC, bringing film-inspired characters, dynamic courts, and new gameplay modes. 

The Retro Party Pack features vintage jerseys honoring teams like the Charlotte Bobcats, New Jersey Nets, Seattle SuperSonics, and Vancouver Grizzlies. It also includes the ability to unlock retro Hardwood Classic logos, old-school basketballs, classic sneakers, and a newspaper trail effect for that vintage flair. The Party Mode features shape-shifting 3-point lines and shrinking rims that add extra challenges to every shot.

NBA Bounce - GOAT: The Movie features the ability to play as Will the Goat, Jett the Black Leopard, Olivia the Ostrich, Lenny the Giraffe, and more from Sony
title: NBA Bounce - GOAT: The Movie: Deluxe Edition - Official Launch Trailer
